statement: Paper B's survivor recursion doubles on a Beatty complement, and the plateau law now has a closed form for where its plateaus are. THE STATEMENT. M_d counts the minimal certificates of length d; neverNegCount_succ_sub_onBarrier (kernel-checked) is N_(d+1) + M_(d+1) = 2 N_d, so the recursion doubles exactly when M_d = 0, which by minimalCertCount_eq_zero_of_window_empty is exactly when no power of three lies in [2^(d-1), 2^d). Those lengths and their complement are M_d != 0 iff d in A020914 = floor(n log2 3) + 1, and M_d = 0 iff d in A054414 minus {1}, with A054414(n) = 1 + floor(n / (1 - log 2 / log 3)); the two partition the positive integers. The exception is d = 1: A054414 contains 1, but the one-letter word E contracts at once, so M_1 = 1 and 1 is a stalling length. COMPUTATIONALLY VERIFIED to d = 200 against both closed forms by a dynamic program on (length, odd count) that also reproduces the Lean recursion at every depth, 0 violations. WHAT IS NEW AND WHAT IS NOT, CHECKED BEFORE CLAIMING. A076227 is already J-paper-b-survivors-are-oeis-a076227; A020914 is used throughout Papers A and B; A100982 is already named in Lean at CollatzBridgeLab.lean as the minimal-certificate count read by length, and the journal carries a Winkler sandwich row on it -- reading M_d along the stalling lengths only, rather than by length with its zeros, gives A100982 with one extra leading term, the same content re-indexed and not a second identification, recorded with its shift stated because an unstated offset produced this branch's A034887 error the same day. A054414 is the ONE sequence the repository had never met: no hit anywhere in docs/, src/, literature/ or formal/ before this row. THE GAIN. The plateau law previously carried three verified instances, density_flat_five_to_six, _eight_to_nine and _ten_to_eleven at d = 6, 9, 11; it now has a description of all of them, the next being 14, 17, 19, 22, 25, 28, 30. PROVENANCE. Identified against a local clone of github.com/oeis/oeisdata, export stamped 2026-09-20T03:00:19-04:00; oeis.org is refused by this environment's egress policy. OEIS content is CC BY-SA 4.0, copyright the OEIS Foundation, and nothing from it is vendored -- only A-numbers, the arithmetic they name, and A100982's 32 stored terms as a verification constant, emitted programmatically from the mirror rather than transcribed after a hand transcription of that same list was found to be correct for twelve terms and invented for twenty. NO LEAN PROOF CHANGED. The identifications were added to docstrings only, because the container had no Lean toolchain -- elan installs, the toolchain download is refused -- and the rebuilt index reports the same 6917 kernel and 56 compiler declarations as before. lake build has NOT been run against these comment edits. Not a bound, not a cycle exclusion, not a floor raise, not a halt theorem; N_0 = 350000000 is untouched. ADDENDUM, same day: the three laboratory sequences the first sweep called absent from OEIS were searched only for contiguous runs, and two of them are SELECTIONS from catalogued families, which a run search cannot find. Pointwise transforms were then tested and none matches (a+-1, a+-2, 2a, 2a+-1, a/2, a+-n, first differences, partial sums). THE ODD COUNTS ARE CATALOGUED: all ten values inside A206788's stored range -- 1, 2, 7, 12, 53, 359, 665, 16266, 31867, 111202 -- are terms of A206788, denominators of semiconvergents to log_2 3; the other three exceed what it stores, a storage limit and not a divergence. THE LENGTHS MATCH NEITHER NEIGHBOUR: nine of thirteen are in A254351, numerators of increasingly better approximations to log 3 / log 2, while 1, 25781, 478245 and 780239 are not, and a scan of the whole database finds NO sequence containing all thirteen -- A254351 keeps only record approximations while the laboratory keeps every semiconvergent the finance bound admits, so the list sits strictly between A005663 and the full semiconvergent numerators. AN APPARENT OFF-BY-ONE, RESOLVED: the laboratory pairs 301994 with 190538 where that convergent's denominator is 190537, and 190538 = ceil(301994 log_3 2) is the laboratory's own pinning o(K), which exceeds the denominator by one when the approximation falls on the other side -- not a transcription slip. THE REPUNIT FLOOR POWERS ARE GENUINELY ABSENT IN BOTH HALVES: the even-a bisection 8^m - 3*2^(m-1) = 5, 58, 500, 4072, 32720, ... and the odd-a Beatty form floor(sqrt 2 * K) were searched separately and neither returns a hit. SECOND ADDENDUM, from the entries' comment fields rather than their terms. (i) A BASE-THREE RESTATEMENT OF THE PLATEAU LAW: a comment of Mohammed Bouayoun (April 2006) characterises A054414 as the exponents n for which 2^n begins with digit 2 in base three; verified here on 1..399 and against the recursion, so Paper B's survivor count doubles at length d exactly when 2^d starts with a ternary 2, with d = 1 the same exception. It is the same fact as no power of three lying in [2^(d-1), 2^d) -- a leading ternary 2 leaves no room for one -- but read in digits rather than inequalities, and the laboratory did not have it. (ii) THE BEATTY COMPLEMENTARITY IS NOT OURS: a comment of Robert G. Wilson v (May 2014) states that A054414 is, except for 1, the complement of A020914 and that the two form a Beatty pair -- the statement derived independently here, exception included, and in print eleven years earlier; A054414 has also carried 'these numbers appear in connection with the 3x+1 problem' since 2006. What remains the laboratory's is the identification of that pair with the plateaus of density_flat_of_window_empty. (iii) THE LEFTOVER ODD COUNTS ARE EQUAL TEMPERAMENTS: A206788 and A060528 define their terms as equal divisions of the octave approximating the perfect fifth and fourth, so 12, 53 and 665 are 12-tone equal temperament, the 53-tone Pythagorean temperament and their successors; the chain is A005664 subset A060528 subset A206788 and the laboratory's counts sit across all three, 16266 lying in A206788 alone. (iv) THE CAP CONSTANT HAS A NAME: log_2 3 - 1 = 0.5849625, the slope of the even-run cap, is recorded on A020857 as the growth exponent for odd coefficients in (1+x)^n mod 2 and as the Hausdorff dimension of the Sierpinski triangle, with the separation exponent 2 - log_2 3 = 0.4150375 its complement; a naming, not a consequence. (v) ADJACENT AND NOT PURSUED: Sloane's conjecture that 2^n has a 0 in its ternary expansion for every n >= 15, and an Eliahou expository piece on non-trivial 3n+1 cycles (CNRS, 2011) absent from the registry. CONVENTION CORRECTION, same day: an earlier addendum read 17026679261 = 6586818670 + 10439860591 as 'the cycle length' of a convergent of log 2 / log 3. That was wrong. There are two conventions. In the SHORTCUT map every step halves, so a cycle with o odd steps and length K has 3^o ~ 2^K and the period is the DENOMINATOR q -- every anchor this laboratory uses is such a q, including Eliahou 1993's 17087915, the leftovers 19, 84, 1054 and 301994, and the floor table's 103768467013. In the UNACCELERATED map an odd step does not halve, so the length is o + h = p + q, and that sum over the convergents is A355512. The two differ by exactly p and coincide only on the degenerate head {1, 2, 3}. So 17026679261 is a p + q and is NOT commensurable with this laboratory's q periods without conversion; it remains a genuine object of the convergent machinery, with its attribution and its intended convention both unsettled. convergent_cycle_lengths in collatz_finance_mirror now returns both readings per convergent, a355512 emits the sequence with the degenerate convergent dropped (the whole of the offset shift), and test_convergent_cycle_lengths_keep_the_two_conventions_apart asserts the two sets meet only at {1, 2, 3} and that 11 and 569 lie in neither, being semiconvergent.
